notes.title: [August 2020 DEVLOG] Tiphareth: New dungeon in the works and 3 new armor sets!
notes.content:
Hello mortals,

here we are again with an update on the development of Dungeon Crowley, these months have been tough with COVID-19 pandemic hitting hard in Brazil, but luckily we are all safe and the project is progressing towards the upcoming Early Access update. We are all really excited to show you everything we have been working on!

[h1]3 New armor sets[/h1]

In Dungeon Crowley you are free to choose which class to focus on during the character's evolution. We added 3 new armor sets: The Warrior, The Samurai and The Archer. Each uses the player's attributes differently. Props to our artist Douglas L. Coelli who polished all the animations and adapted them from 1st to 3rd person view!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33595455/35876378f5b3e8bce96fc7c027066909cdbee231.jpg[/img]

All armors in the game are carefully prepared to be compatible with first and third person interactions. Our artist Douglas Coelli was responsible for the adaptation, completely redesigning the animations and improving the textures. So, which one do you intend to play with?

[h1]New Dungeon: Tiphareth[/h1]

Also, we are already working on a new dungeon: Tiphareth. For the first time on his journey, the Neophyte now is face to face to pure knowledge, but don't get to cozy with the warm of Tiphareth, real danger also lies there. Check it out and let us know what you think:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33595455/fed8dace398d289dc658832f271a0c51d6a460d9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33595455/3760b11b7c9b6c51b965eb1e0c463fba183b0ce2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33595455/a897e36305e093007ccf15153acac2e2914d3dd9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33595455/1c3383fb1cd784ea06e91f00ed88122144b05b24.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33595455/feeed111c02f17769765fd83b2ea8f8acabe24a0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33595455/ef3b58ffd6f4a7bedadcd95e9f1675d9f94033dc.jpg[/img]


[h1]A nice GIF and lore about our Netzach dungeon[/h1]

Although powerful, the intellect alone does not empower Neophyte. He begins to perceive for the first time a peculiar imbalance, and once again, he finds himself trapped.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33595455/72724c333b3e6fbb486c9d5bab04440d9f3d9165.gif[/img]

Doubt transforms certainties into questions and through this warm transmutation of frustration and anger, he realizes the disharmony that afflicted him: he lacked emotional sensitivity.
In order to better understand this nature the Neophyte goes to the seventh sephira ritual, Netzach, now in search of his inner artist.

Located in the right column of the Tree of Life at the Pillar of Mercy, Netzach deals with an emotional and instinctual plane, intuition and the senses arise beyond the intellect. In search of balance between his mind and his emotions, he ventures again, this time, in the icy fields of Netzach.

Stay safe, and expect more news about Dungeon Crowley soon,
Animvs Game Studio

tags.feature: We added 3 new armor sets: The Warrior, The Samurai and The Archer.
Also, we are already working on a new dungeon: Tiphareth.

notes.title: March 2020 Devlog Update: New Dungeon Area, Blocking AI, Randomizing Levels
notes.content:
Hello dear mortals,

hope you all are doing good, this month of March has been a bit hectic on our side, the Coronavirus pandemic came and, as with many other people, impacted our daily lives, luckily we are all healthy and taking the recommended hygienic and distance measures while we keep the quarantine. 

Here follows the more remarkable progresses done during this month of Dungeon Crowley development:

[list]
[*] We have been working on our main door model, it was designed to easily transmit progress info to the player. It can be found all over the place in dungeons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33595455/ec6159c203321558d57c8e08096ef44f65de4a78.gif[/img]

[*] Currently working on the blocking behavior in some enemies so we improve the combat dynamics and their pace.

Now, the enemies switch to defense mode, and stays for 2-3 secs.

Do you have any tips on how the player could break that defense?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33595455/03b1dc5a2d72f0d44aff8b9122628e1148171689.gif[/img]

[*]We are working on an early prototype of the new-coming Hod Dungeon.
Hod is the 8th sephirah of the Kabbalistic tree of life. Its color is orange and there ideas are worked on by facts and not by feelings, so we look for a more robust and warm dungeon design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33595455/757fd0e1a8f8529e6e3c1d2ea072298b25b3f2cc.jpg[/img]

[*]Finally, we would like to present a short introduction on the relationship with the Thoth tarot and the Kabbalistic Tree of life on which Dungeon Crowley's game design is firmly based upon.

Joining those two distinct views of the universe was a continuous work developed over years amongst great minds, but we can extrapolate to say that the ultimate convergence of these [before opposite concepts], was conceived by Mr. Aleister Crowley and painted by Lady Frieda Harris, creating a set of archetypes known as the Thoth Tarot.

In our dual existence we trend to naturally stipulate antagonistic concepts, love and hate, heat and cold, but the Universe doesn't differentiate those:

"Learn now that Impressions of Sense have Opposites readily conceived, as long to short, or light to dark; and so with Emotions and Perceptions, as Love to Hate, or False to True; but the more Violent the Antagonism, the more is it bound in Illusion, determined by Relation."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33595455/cf82dbed2216e45ee38cd12bf6db23f450efade3.gif[/img]

Happy reading: [url=https://www.tarotica.net/tarot--the-tree-of-life.html]https://www.tarotica.net/tarot--the-tree-of-life.html[/url]

[/list]

Stay tuned for more news, and above all, stay safe!
Animvs Game Studio

notes.title: Feb.2020 Devlog Update: Pathway randomization & minimap are already in the game.
notes.content:
Hello dear mortals,

we are moving forward with the development, and as we implement the basic structure of the campaign mode, we are also improving level design procedural routines and added a mini-map. Here are the most recent updates we shared on social media:

In this room from Yesod dungeon the neophyte will discover the basic secrets of Magick, allowing him to use staffs to launch spells through a tutorial.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33595455/88e7622839424121355c6fa68d03c23333db5515.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33595455/89679013e9bc21e19de473202139b8f8230f9120.jpg[/img]

Implemented pathway randomization. Simple modifications in pre-crafted to improve player's experience each time they play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33595455/388f127ba582112941444ff794b33be6e4333d2a.gif[/img]

Lost? Don't worry, we're working on a mini-map to help crawling through our procedurally designed dungeons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33595455/9c66653e48dd5346cd7eb0dc7f630f7fecfd44d8.jpg[/img]

We finished our mini-map 1st implementation, see it on the upper-right corner of the screen.

What do you think about its design and size? Would you re-orientate it according to the players cone of sight?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33595455/570bdf305cbc94613d0d0b1229b716da307b712f.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for more news, 
Animvs Game Studio

notes.title: January 2020 Devlog Update: Rituals and new Dungeon Generation System
notes.content:
Hello dear mortals,

today we want to show you the progress we made in the rituals animations and the way dungeons are generated.

Here is a finished ritual pose. This is the end resulting model rendered inside Unreal Engine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33595455/54423631f0780b438a413a7efd90b8c2e5d47447.gif[/img]

The rituals are used to teleport the player to the different dungeons. We can finally show a finished ritual pose animation, let us know what do you think.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33595455/764e331527ef4b705e8f058ff84e3dc20162506e.gif[/img]

This last weeks we have been working on a new algorithm for level creation that allows decoration and even gameplay details to be changed from pre-defined states, creating a new layer of randomized content; and thus improving the feeling of "something not seen before" in the game room details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33595455/717c400db222edfb2ac807e9e853c6e64ea6fbb9.gif[/img]

We keep working on the above mentioned and many other features, will keep the community hub and social media profiles (Facebook, Instagram and Twitter) regularly updated with our further progresses.

Stay tuned,
Animvs Game Studio

notes.title: Patch 0.33
notes.content:
Greetings, Mortals!

Patch 0.33 brings a lot of game-play improvements; foes now have specific AI behaviors, thus, requiring a little more tactical combat. 
We suggest an start-over since we've completely re-worked the [b]first two levels[/b] along with the new ai system. Other levels will be be improved next.

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
[b]New AI behaviors[/b]: specific ai written for each enemy. This is a great improvement towards how the gameplay should be on its final state
[b]Game-play balance improved[/b]: the first two levels where completely rebalanced taking the new ai behaviors in consideration.
Wake-up cut-scene

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
First two challenges updated
Mimic chests probability updated
Consumable drop rates updated
Multi-player level increase algorithm updated
Unreal engine upgraded to 4.22
Foe homing projectiles
Damage texts now shows "BLOCKED" instead of "0.0"
AI algorithm revised (cpu performance improvement)

[h1]FIXES[/h1]
Graveyard's door frame removed
Projectile light being abruptly disposed
Crash during startup (audio)
Foes not targeting distant players after receiving damaged

This is a rather large patch with a lot of changes, please report any issues that you might find.

notes.title: Corrupted Save-Games
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

Unfortunately we had some problems with the save-games on the patches released today / yesterday, those are fixed now (please update to last version: 0.30.4), but if you had played while using version 0.30 or 0.30.1 you save-game may had become corrupted which may cause "random" crashes and excessive memory usage.

2. Send your save-game files to [b]support@animvs.com[/b], so we can take a look.

Sorry for the inconvenience.

Please let us know if we can help with anything.

notes.title: Patch 0.30.1
notes.content:
Greetings, Mortals!

This patch highlights a important feature: new identifying system. Also a lot of changes on game's loot:

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]

[b]New identify system[/b]: re-written from scratch. Now, identifying items requires placing them on a shortcut for a while, (identifiers items where dumped). The time required to identify items can be improved by a new modifier called "identify power".
[b]Desert sub-level 2[/b]: the desert level was expanded and changed to better fit the upcoming new desert theme levels.
[b]New Loot System[/b]: Loot was redesigned and a bunch new modifiers where added: 
[list]
[*][b]Luck[/b]: increases better loot probality
[*][b]attributes bonus / penalties[/b]: affects main attributes (STR, DEX, INT)
[*][b]Identify power[/b]: Reduces the time required to identify items
[*][b]Movement speed[/b]: increases player's movement speed 
[*][b]Stronger durability[/b]: causes weapons to loose less durability over-time
[*][b]Weapon speed[/b]: increases weapon speed (thus, increasing damage per second)
[*][b]Class exchange[/b]: Allows weapons to be used by other attributes other 
than the original requirement, while applying a damage penalty
[/list]

This new system stands as a more solid basis on how loot works, and will receive further work / adjustments for now on.

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

Attribute summary: tool-tip added to player's UI describing how each attribute is composed (invested points + equipment modifiers)
Damage summary: tool-tip added to player's UI describing the character damage (taking attribute bonus and equipment modifiers in consideration).
Inventory slot performance improved: refactored to consume less CPU.
Item description tool-tips: where added to better explain items properties.
Consumable drop rate adjusted (still requires more work).
"R" key can be used to auto-equip / auto-identify items (from both, inventory and from the ground).
Main menu sync load: makes the initial screen more responsive while the resources still loading in background.
PT-BR translations updated.

[h1]FIXES[/h1]

Gamma settings and Push to talk not being saved
Willpower increase modifier not working
Revised some unbalanced modifiers on high levels
Desert second level not being loaded

Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch 0.29
notes.content:
Greetings, Mortals!

Great news:
This is a big patch, we've made a complete overhaul of game's core algorithm, the revision of important aspects such as Foe's AI allowed us to achieve a great cpu performance boost even doubling the amount of concurrent enemies.

We've expanded game's content, adding new sub-levels to each existing theme, new Foes where also added to all of them.

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]

Refactored foes AI (big CPU performance improvement).
Foes re-balance: we've increased the amount of Foes in the game. This is something we've long planned to better comfort our type of game, but some changes should had been addressed prior doing this. Enemies attributes where also re-balanced to fit this new style.
Game expansion: We've pushed out the vertical-slice presentation of our current dungeon themes expanding them. All existing themes where affected, most of the time being increased on its size and there is now sub-levels for Old Village and Dark Temple.
Diversified game-play (mini puzzles): still very bare-bones, but now you'll find find-the-right-lever and jump-to-safety puzzles. That kind of stuff is something we'll be moving towards and improving in the future.
Equipment decay system: broken equipment are no longer dropped into the ground, instead, each player's slot displays a color on its background refering to the current durability of the equipped item. When a item reaches low durability a icon is also shown on the screen.
Engage AI: this one starts a serie of new behaviors to be implemented. Engaged foes will circulates around its target and attack eventually instead of the simple seek / kill behavior.
Complete refactored existing Desert and Dark temple challenges.
Persistent checkpoints: they are now persisted on save-game, allowing you to resume from the last one even after restarting the game. This system still very bare-bones, but it is the base architecture for the upcoming fast-trave system.

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

Steam friends sorted by who is currently playing the game.
Filter steam friends by name.
HLOD generated for some static transition maps (GPU performance improvement).
Desert dungeon entrance moved to main-hub.
New level stream algorithm.
Dungeons generation algorithm updated (more rooms and better randomized areas).
Melee attacks now causes knockdown to foes most of the time.
Health and willpower fully replenished when Players level-up.
Pt-br Localization updated.

[h1]FIXES[/h1]

On screen damage text not being destroyed (memory requirements improvement).
Scaled Foe's level on multi-player.
Unidentified items won't show any properties anymore.
Status bar now displays character name instead of player name FIX: Project settings updated.
Old village light.
Levers refactored.
Catacombs challenge's success not loading reward totem and lever.
Duplicated challenge's bosses on clients.
Projectiles won't push foes anymore causing stuttering on them.

This is an major update, so there still a plenty of stuff to improve / fix, new patches will be rolled out on the following days addressing those. Please report your issues.

Enjoy!
Regards.

notes.title: Patch 0.28.5

Hail, Dreamers! 

Take a second to check out our latest patch notes and feature additions below. We will continue to polish and update every aspect of the game well after implementation, so we ask that you please continue to submit your feedback (and hopefully update your reviews!). The community we build is very important to us, and to you!

-New colored loot beams! (allows targeting to view/interact with items)

-Improved checkpoints to avoid never-ending load bug
-Fixed bugs preventing certain assets from loading properly

Stay tuned for many more updates, including a big announcement in the coming weeks detailing some of the more exciting and game changing features you can expect to see along our roadmap of development.

Early Access is about taking as much abuse as necessary from our fans and critics alike, so bring it on! Your passion for a quality product continues to drive us forward, and we appreciate all of you. Thank you.

Best regards.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch 0.27
notes.content:
Greetings, mortals.

We'd been very busy for the past week preparing this massive update to the game. [b]Version 0.27[/b] is alive! We hope that you finds it as much fun as we did.

[b]FEATURES[/b]:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33595455/c4676d44a6913c65b95f0ff4969ac1c0b5c8240e.jpg[/img]

[b]New level Graveyard:[/b] Completely new level after the Old Village (first level).
Custom key-bindings: Input can be customized through Controls UI on the main menu. Key-bindings still not save after the game is close, that will be implemented soon.



[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33595455/c6d9b05196e52de302e0d082802bb97fc892dd8a.jpg[/img]

[b]Checkpoints:[/b] Global checkpoints are triggered by any player and shared by all of them. 
Customized crosshairs.
Text chat: press enter at any moment and chat with your friends
Console commands: use [i]"/"[/i] preceed commands on chat screen to use commands such as: [i]/stat FPS [/i] and [i]/stat unit[/i]



[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33595455/17dc6e8bb3378ec4f43400bfc49e76c52f42116f.jpg[/img]

[b]IMPROVEMENTS:[/b]

[b]Performance:[/b] All Entire game levels where  revised to [b]improve performance[/b], some circumstantial aspects of the game where also changed to allow dungeons to unload (thus, freeing resources and improving the overall frame-rate)
Player weapon's animation revised
Audio mix
ESC menu design

And a LOT of bug fixes, although many other may be present on the on the current version due the massive amount of additions we've made on the last 10 days.
On the next 4 days we'll be focusing strictly in solving those bugs while publishing patches on daly basis. So we're counting on you to report them; fell free to use our Steam forums, discord channel or e-mail. 

Enjoy!
Regards.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33595455/4284722a9c640809e065a694e746457802953312.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Upcoming Patch (0.26)
notes.content:
Greetings Mortals!

First we would like to thank everyone for playing. The community feedback is our main tool to properly shape our final-product.
We're working hard to deploy weekly updates. We also had the chance to increase our player-database since we just launched the early access version. With that in mind, this week patch will be performance / fixes oriented in order to provide an smooth experience.

Among another topics, you may find the following implementations on this weekly patch:

Missing Desert Vases
Low willpower, low health, level-up and quest-item collection feedback

Interfaces revision

[b]Bugs:[/b]

Client sync issues 
Damage post-effect bad performance
PT-BR localization revision

Thanks for your time.
As always, feel free to send us your suggestions about the game.

Best regards!
